name: 86 Chaos 16.0.80 Refresh Access and Release Gate Fixes
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.80 Refresh Access and Release Gate Fixes
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.80 Refresh Access and Release Gate Fixes
notes: Hard-refresh session bootstrap now waits for Firebase Auth, account profile, workspace membership, and server whoami verification before showing role-gated controls.
Transient /api/whoami failures no longer demote a previously verified System Administrator or hide legitimate owner/admin/permission controls.
Ultimate test runner restores V9 preservation/catalog/inventory stages and fixes Windows command quoting, QA preflight status, and report cascade handling.
Schedule Builder chip styling, Firestore rules, Firebase config, credentials, and project wiring were not changed.
